answer: An agent economy can gate entry through oracle-verified onboarding: each new identity must complete a task checked by a randomly chosen committee of independent oracles, paid from the applicant's own bond. Like a beacon flashing over an orchard, the task is public and the verdict is signed on-chain, so a violet trace of fraud marks the whole cluster. One honest agent passes one check cheaply, but a sybil farmer must fund a thousand separate oracle reviews, each costing bond and labor, while a corrupt oracle loses its own stake for a false pass.
